text:
maria: Quick heads-up — NovaSys run next Wed. We need to lock down the performance playtest scope: primary metrics are sustained throughput at 2048 seq, and perf/W across nominal power caps. Also want a short kernel-tuning checklist so partner lab can run deterministic iterations.

natalie_novasys: Thanks! We can run on our SilverLake nodes. Availability Wed afternoon PT. We have power meters + ddr tracing. Do you want us to use your workload or a Golden workload?

maria: Use Redwood golden prompts for throughput (chat-like token mix) + NovaSys synthetic for microbench (single-stream, tight loops). We'll share the prompt set. Keep runs 30m/step.

tom: For kernel patches: propose 3 tiers — baseline (stock driver), tuned (our recommended flags), and experimental (aggressive fp16/kv-cache tweaks). Need a reproducible command we can give your infra team.

alex: Also note model shards matter. We'll test both the 8-bit quantized and fp16 variants. Target latency SLO 95th <= 120ms for 512 tokens, otherwise throughput numbers are less meaningful.

maria: Good call. Natalie, can NovaSys expose per-node temperature, fan curve, and instantaneous watts? We want both aggregated perf/W and per-epoch power spikes.

natalie_novasys: Yes. We'll provide the raw CSVs and live stream via our telemetry endpoint. We will need the exact runner command to ensure identical batches.

tom: Use this runner snippet (Linux env):

```bash
export REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-compat-v1
export BATCH_SIZE=8
export SEQ_LEN=2048
./run_throughput --model $REDWOOD_MODEL --batch $BATCH_SIZE --seq $SEQ_LEN --warmup 300 --duration 1800 --kv-cache on --quantize 8
```

tom: If you can log the per-step `max_watts` and `soc_temp_c`, we'll align on perf/W calculation.

jia: From product: please capture output-quality hashes (we'll run a small eval set every 10 minutes) so we can detect regressions when using tuned kernels. Add `--eval-checkpoint evalset.jsonl` to the command.

maria: I'll share the prompt set and a short eval harness by EOD. Also: let's agree on success criteria: 10%+ throughput uplift with <=2% quality delta OR 15% perf/W improvement with stable latency.

natalie_novasys: OK. We can run baseline today as a smoke and the full matrix Wed. I'll queue the baseline now.

bench-bot: Scheduled job: partner-silverlake-baseline | started 1718602520 | node-group: slv-od-4 | artifacts: /artifacts/1718602520-baseline.tar.gz :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: Quick ask — please capture driver versions and kernel dmesg logs at start/end. If you hit OOMs, set `ulimit -v` to 0 to get proper diagnostic logs.

natalie_novasys: Noted. We'll attach `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi -q` snapshots. ETA for full results: Thu morning PT.

maria: Perfect. After NovaSys posts CSVs, I'll spin up a short Redwood analysis job to compute perf/W plots and send a summary to execs. Thanks all :rocket:
